Run the Huff or conditional logit model from raw inputs

Source: R/08-spax_run.R
spax_huff.Rd

Experimental. spax_huff() and spax_clm() prepare the data with prep_data(), specify the model with spec_huff() or spec_clm() and run it with spax(), in one call: spax_huff(demand, supply, travel, observed = ...) is spax(prep_data(demand, supply, travel), spec_huff(), observed = ...). See spax() for fitting, evaluation and the result.

Usage

spax_huff(
  demand,
  supply,
  travel,
  observed = NULL,
  decay = decay_power(),
  beta = "fit",
  kappa = 1,
  by_group = character(),
  data_args = list(),
  ...
)

spax_clm(
  demand,
  supply,
  travel,
  observed = NULL,
  decay = decay_gaussian(),
  outside = "fit",
  beta = 1,
  kappa = 1,
  by_group = character(),
  data_args = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

demand, supply, travel

The inputs of prep_data(): demand by origin (a named list by group for demand groups), supply by facility and the origin-by-facility travel matrix.

observed

Observed counts, as in spax(): an obs_flows() or obs_totals() object, or raw counts. NULL (the default) evaluates a model that has a value for every parameter.

decay

The decay of the model: a decay object (decay_gaussian() and its relatives), an exact kernel name, a decay_kernel(), or a named list of these by demand group. The default is the power decay for spax_huff() and the Gaussian for spax_clm().

beta

The attractiveness exponent: "fit" (the default for spax_huff()) or a positive number (the default 1 for spax_clm()).

kappa

A single finite number greater than 0, the scale of the attractiveness (kappa * supply)^beta. It is held.

by_group

For data with demand groups, the parameters that differ by group, as in spec_clm(): "sigma" and, for spax_clm(), "v0".

data_args

A named list of further arguments of prep_data(), for example list(missing_demand = "exclude", metadata = list(travel_units = "minutes")).

...

Further arguments of spax(): starts, lower, upper and the arguments of fit_allocation() or evaluate_allocation().

outside

The outside weight v0 of spax_clm(): "fit" (the default), 0 for no outside option, a positive number, or a value by group (see spec_clm()). The Huff model has no outside option.

Value

A spax_allocation as returned by spax(), with the one-shot call as its call.

See also

Other allocation interface: decay_gaussian(), obs_flows(), prep_data(), spax(), spax_allocation-methods, spec_clm()

Examples

areas <- sf::st_drop_geometry(cornwall_lsoa[!cornwall_lsoa$scilly, ])
gp <- sf::st_drop_geometry(cornwall_gp[!cornwall_gp$scilly, ])
flows <- obs_flows(cornwall_flows, origin = "lsoa", facility = "practice",
                   count = "patients")

# Fit Huff from raw inputs in one call
huff <- spax_huff(
  demand = stats::setNames(areas$registered_in, areas$lsoa),
  supply = stats::setNames(gp$gp_fte_extg, gp$practice),
  travel = cornwall_travel[areas$lsoa, gp$practice],
  observed = flows
)
#> observed: 2,290 counts from 1 origin outside the data or left out by it are dropped; 5 counts at 1 facility outside the data are dropped (the Huff model has no outside option)
coef(huff)
#>     sigma      beta 
#> 2.3928431 0.4862684
